query:
select exists (
               select 1 from identities i join principals p on p.id = i.principal_id
               where p.merged_into = $2 and i.id <> $3
                 and exists (
                     select 1 from messages m
                     where m.conversation_id = $1 and m.sender_identity_id = i.id
                 )
           ) as "found!"
